summary:
• Cursor voice chat — a live voice call interface for the coding agent, adding audible feedback and hands‑free interaction while preserving privacy.
• Gemini Omni Flash — Google's generative video model that creates up to fifteen‑second clips with multi‑turn editing, reducing cost and iteration time for marketers and designers.
• Claude Code privacy mod — a community‑built plugin that strips user‑identifying headers from web searches, preventing email leakage and improving agent privacy by default.
• NVIDIA Cosmos 3 checkpoints — open‑weight models for interactive world simulation that generate synchronized camera and LiDAR streams, enabling synthetic data for autonomous‑vehicle and robotics research.
• Agentic Hacking Skills repository — an open‑source collection of AI‑driven security playbooks and configurations that let compatible models execute automated penetration‑testing workflows with minimal setup.
• Meta Spaces — a sidebar panel in Muse agents that provides a persistent, topic‑focused canvas for organizing project context and integrating external data sources.
